title: Weapon Maker
altTitles: ウェポン・クリエーター
description: Shin Joonseoh is a D-rank support with little mana but a rare Creation ability. After joining the Dawon Guild for his weapon-making talent, he nearly dies during a dungeon raid and awakens the memories of his past life, in which he failed to prevent the end of the world. Armed with those memories and experience, he begins a new journey to change the future and save the world.
author: Seo Taerang
